in_sanskrit.name: Giniya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Gauri's grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Giniya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Giniya is derived from the Sanskrit language, where it is believed to represent the grace and blessings of the Hindu goddess Gauri. Gauri is the consort of Lord Shiva and is revered for her beauty, fertility, and nurturing qualities. The name Giniya is therefore associated with these divine traits, symbolizing blessings, grace, and nurturing energy.
